status_detail: City says Archer proposes up to 500,000 square feet of data center buildings on about 87 acres south of 150th Street West and east of Acorn Trail; no formal land-use applications had been submitted at the time of the city page, but EAW review was filed and public comment ran May 20-June 20, 2025. MPR reported in June 2026 that the appeals court required more environmental study.
notes: Official city page provides site size/building scope; tracker and DCD reporting give 120 MW and expected year. Status kept planned because environmental review/appeal remained unresolved.

status_detail: Centersquare/Csquare lists its Shakopee MSP1 data center in the Minneapolis market with 29,800 square feet of raised floor and 19.1 MW combined utility power; third-party facility listings show the Shakopee campus at 4450 Dean Lakes Boulevard with 50,000 square feet and 10 MW access. Cleanview lists Centersquare MSP1 as operating in Scott County with 10 MW capacity.
notes: City of Shakopee separately confirms an existing data center near a new Dean Lakes project at 4450 Dean Lakes Boulevard.

project_name: Dean Lakes Industrial Park data center
status_detail: City of Shakopee says a data center is under construction in an existing industrial building in the Dean Lakes Industrial Park; it uses an existing industrial-zoned property, was reviewed administratively through zoning/building permitting, and does not require a City Council vote.
notes: The city states this is smaller/non-hyperscale, enclosed air-cooled, using a closed-loop cooling system and existing electrical system. Developer/name/address not disclosed in the city fact sheet beyond Dean Lakes Industrial Park.

status_detail: MPR reported Microsoft bought about 295 acres from Xcel Energy in Becker for a future data center; Cleanview lists a planned Becker Data Center by Microsoft at 325 MW expected in 2026. Project details and construction timeline remain limited publicly.
notes: Becker is in Sherburne County; some trackers label county as 'Becker' because they are using city/location field, so county normalized here to Sherburne.

status_detail: Amazon bought roughly 348-350 acres in Becker for a data center project in 2024, then paused/suspended/scrapped development in 2025 while evaluating other locations. Cleanview lists AWS Becker as canceled with 383 MW capacity.
notes: Status set rejected to fit requested enum for abandoned/canceled projects; articles describe Amazon as pausing/suspending plans rather than a formal local denial.

status_detail: Google explored a $600 million data center near the Sherco power plant in Becker beginning around 2017-2019, but pulled out in late 2022 after the electric service agreement was terminated.
notes: Included for completeness because brief says rejected/abandoned projects count. Same general Becker/Sherco area later saw Microsoft and Amazon land transactions.

status_detail: City of Hermantown describes a proposed communications-services/data-center project in southwest Hermantown near Midway Road and Highway 2, with up to four data center buildings and supporting infrastructure. The city page says applications were received in October 2025, later paused for EQB petition/litigation/public engagement, and in 2026 the city considered AUAR scoping plus development and tax-abatement agreements. MPR reported Google is behind the proposal.
notes: Official city page does not name Google in the main project FAQ excerpts but links to Google's Hermantown presentation; MPR identifies Google. City says initial building would have at least 40 full-time jobs, 100+ at full build-out, and municipal/domestic water use up to about 50,000 gallons/day.
